title: A type-generic max
description:
Write three functions and a `_Generic` macro that picks the right one by the type of the first argument:

```c
int max_int(int a, int b);
double max_double(double a, double b);
const char *max_string(const char *a, const char *b);   /* the one that sorts later (strcmp) */

#define max(a, b) ...                                   /* int, double, char * and const char * */
```

```c
max(3, 9)            /* 9 */
max(2.5, -1.0)       /* 2.5 */
max("pear", "apple") /* "pear" */
```
hints: `_Generic((a), int: max_int, double: max_double, ...)` evaluates to a function; put `((a), (b))` after it to call that function.
A string literal has type `char *` in a `_Generic` (it decays to a pointer to its first character), while a `const char *` variable is `const char *`: list both.
